metadata.description: keydrop — hand API keys and passwords to a coding agent through a one-time page instead of the chat

plugins.name: keydrop
plugins.description: Agent skill that opens a one-time secret input page on your Tailscale address (or localhost) so you can paste an API key from your phone or another device. The value goes straight to a .env file, the macOS Keychain or any command that reads stdin (gh secret set, secret-tool, …) and never enters the conversation. Python standard library only.
